meta.title: Offline model training · artifacts and stateless research UI

messages.label: Fit 4 MLP + 2 LinearSVC candidates on Train
messages.note: TfidfVectorizer(preprocessor=normalize_classification); measure Validation Macro-F1. No Train+Validation refit.

messages.label: Write selection.json BEFORE any Test predict
messages.note: Choose highest Validation Macro-F1; tie favors LinearSVC. Within family, first maximum wins.

messages.label: At process import: load mlp + linearsvc + selection
messages.note: Artifact handoff; training does not invoke or reload the running server. New artifacts require new Engine/process.

messages.label: research_route() → route() → strip evidence → JSON
messages.note: Per-request mode only. Missing explicit model → 503; no generation, history writes or default mode mutation.

cards.title: Evidence and uncertainty
items: VERIFIED = inspected source at ded15187b5fe; source references are static evidence, not runtime traces.
INFERRED = configuration-based deployment assumption; explicitly prefixed on its arrow.
No origin remote exists. Source paths and pinned excerpts are available in source.html; no remote identity is invented.

cards.title: Separate FAQ evaluation
items: evaluate_faq.main() creates Engine(), rebuilds from data/faqs.json and routes technical cases for all four modes.
It writes reports/faq-evaluation.json without loading the student conversation DB or calling generate().
intent.joblib is a selected copy for reporting/backup; Engine.__init__ actually loads the two named pipelines.

cards.title: Preparation is optional
items: scripts/prepare_data.py reads supplied DOCX tables + saved article/dorm JSON, writes original_50.csv, faqs.json and data_manifest.json.
prepare_data.py is a curation utility; normal startup seeds from existing faqs.json only when the FAQ table is empty.
